entities.summary: Murat Georgievich Gassiev is a Russian professional boxer. He has held the World Boxing Association (WBA) heavyweight title since 2025. Previously, he held the unified cruiserweight championship; having held the IBF title from 2016 to 2018, and WBA (Unified) title in 2018.
